items.body:
### Problem

Autocommands on the Nightly branch that return something other than `nil` from their Lua callbacks are deleted and not run again. This initially came up in this issue on my project https://github.com/Olical/nfnl/issues/36

### Steps to reproduce

With the following Lua in your plugin / configuration:

```lua
local function callback()
  print("EXECUTED")
  return {foo = true} -- A numerical value also causes the issue, maybe others too but I've only tried table and number so far.
end
vim.api.nvim_create_autocmd({"Filetype"}, {callback = callback})
```

You should see "EXECUTED" printed once then never again, even if you repeatedly `:e` different files.

### Expected behavior

"EXECUTED" should be printed multiple times on every Filetype autocommand execution. You can also see the autocmd under `:autocmd Filetype` initially then see it vanish after the first execution. This does not happen on stable, only on Nightly.

### Neovim version (nvim -v)

v0.10.0-dev-2755+ge1ff2c51c

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

No, this is only in Neovim nightly.

### Operating system/version

Linux and Windows users have seen this so far.

### Terminal name/version

Kitty 0.33.0

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-256color

### Installation

Manual .appimage download from GitHub, latest build from today

labels.description: current behavior is by design, and change is not desired
labels.name: closed:wontfix

items.title: Auto commands with Lua callbacks that return Lua tables are removed after they are executed
